summary: I fixed the bug by changing one file, `solution/core.py`, and all 3 visible tests now pass. There were two off-by-one errors that each worked against the column width the table had already calculated. First, the wrap loop in `_cell_lines` used `while len(line) > width - 1`. That split any line exactly as long as the column, leaving a stray empty line under it: that's the blank `|       |` row under "header" in the failing output. Second, `_align` set the padding to `width - len(text) - 1`, so every cell came out one space short and didn't line up with the `+----+` borders. I changed the wrap condition to `len(line) > width` and the padding to `width - len(text)`. Both now use the full column width, so wrapping, padding and borders agree for left, right and centre alignment.
